actions.script:
import java.time.LocalDate import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
def now = LocalDate.now() def fysSetting = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.base.CompanySettings").condition("organizationPartyId", ec.user.getPreference("ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION")).condition("settingKey", "FY_START_MONTH").one() int fyStartMonth = fysSetting ? (fysSetting.settingValue as int) : 4 int fyStart = now.monthValue >= fyStartMonth ? now.year : now.year - 1 String fySuffix = String.format("%02d-%02d", fyStart % 100, (fyStart + 1) % 100)
def lastVehicle = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.fleet.Vehicle") .condition("vehicleNumber", "like", "VH/${fySuffix}/%").orderBy("-vehicleNumber").limit(1).list() int nextSeq = 1 if (lastVehicle) { def parts = lastVehicle[0].vehicleNumber.split("/") if (parts.length == 3) nextSeq = (parts[2] as int) + 1 } String vehicleNumber = "VH/${fySuffix}/" + String.format("%05d", nextSeq)
context.vehicleId = vehicleId ?: ec.entity.sequencedIdPrimary("zenith.erp.fleet.Vehicle", null, null) ec.entity.makeValue("zenith.erp.fleet.Vehicle").setAll([ vehicleId: context.vehicleId, vehicleNumber: vehicleNumber, registrationNumber: registrationNumber, vehicleType: vehicleType, make: make, model: model, yearOfManufacture: yearOfManufacture, engineNumber: engineNumber, chassisNumber: chassisNumber, fuelType: fuelType, color: color, seatingCapacity: seatingCapacity, loadCapacityKg: loadCapacityKg, currentOdometerKm: 0, statusId: "VhActive", purchaseDate: purchaseDate, purchaseAmount: purchaseAmount, ownershipType: ownershipType, facilityId: facilityId, fastagNumber: fastagNumber, fastagProvider: fastagProvider ]).setSequencedIdPrimary().create()

import java.sql.Date as SqlDate import java.time.LocalDate
def cutoff = SqlDate.valueOf(LocalDate.now().plusDays(daysAhead ?: 30)) int count = 0
def vehicles = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.fleet.Vehicle") .condition("statusId", "VhActive").list() for (def v : vehicles) { boolean expiring = false if (v.insuranceExpiryDate && v.insuranceExpiryDate <= cutoff) expiring = true if (v.fitnessExpiryDate && v.fitnessExpiryDate <= cutoff) expiring = true if (v.pucExpiryDate && v.pucExpiryDate <= cutoff) expiring = true if (v.permitExpiryDate && v.permitExpiryDate <= cutoff) expiring = true if (v.roadTaxExpiryDate && v.roadTaxExpiryDate <= cutoff) expiring = true if (expiring) count++ } context.expiringCount = count ec.message.addMessage("Found ${count} vehicles with documents expiring within ${daysAhead} days")
